result.title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
result.summary: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究视觉智能体能否仅靠少量任务和记录好的交互历史完成蒸馏，提出以技能-上下文覆盖和有序视觉决策相似度筛选代表性轨迹，再在选定任务或固定历史上做 on-policy distillation，并在 Navigation、Sokoban 与空间建图任务上验证少量经验即可迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有序视觉决策相似度」的轨迹筛选和在固定历史下的 on-policy 监督，可能为 LVR 交互轨迹训练中的数据选择、监督信号分配和长期迁移提供可核查线索；但论文未涉及内部 latent 状态，故属方法借鉴而非直接竞争。
